signature: SUBROUTINE DLAEDA( N, TLVLS, CURLVL, CURPBM, PRMPTR, PERM, GIVPTR,

params.name: N
params.reference: The dimension of the symmetric tridiagonal matrix. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: tlvls
params.reference: The total number of merging levels in the overall divide and conquer tree.

params.name: curlvl
params.reference: The current level in the overall merge routine, 0 \<= curlvl \<= tlvls.

params.name: curpbm
params.reference: The current problem in the current level in the overall merge routine (counting from upper left to lower right).

params.name: PRMPTR
params.reference: Contains a list of pointers which indicate where in `PERM` a level's permutation is stored. `PRMPTR(i+1)` - `PRMPTR(i)` indicates the size of the permutation and incidentally the size of the full, non-deflated problem.

params.name: PERM
params.reference: Contains the permutations (from deflation and sorting) to be applied to each eigenblock.

params.name: GIVPTR
params.reference: Contains a list of pointers which indicate where in `GIVCOL` a level's Givens rotations are stored. `GIVPTR(i+1)` - `GIVPTR(i)` indicates the number of Givens rotations.

params.name: GIVCOL
params.reference: Each pair of numbers indicates a pair of columns to take place in a Givens rotation.

params.name: GIVNUM
params.reference: Each number indicates the S value to be used in the corresponding Givens rotation.

params.name: q
params.reference: Contains the square eigenblocks from previous levels, the starting positions for blocks are given by `QPTR`.

params.name: QPTR
params.reference: Contains a list of pointers which indicate where in Q an eigenblock is stored. SQRT( `QPTR(i+1)` - `QPTR(i)` ) indicates the size of the block.

params.name: z
params.reference: On output this vector contains the updating vector (the last row of the first sub-eigenvector matrix and the first row of the second sub-eigenvector matrix).

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit.
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.
